name: Napa County, CA
findings: Napa County has 628 nonprofit organizations. 291 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 219 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Napa County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
